messages:
rachael: quick follow-up from today's all-hands reorg slide — a few manager questions floated that I want to capture here.
jamie: thanks! can we get a short checklist for managers that covers comms + product handoffs?
rachael: yes. we'll publish a Manager Handoff checklist w/ templates. key items: customer comms, backlog triage, on-call ownership, and 1:1s for impacted ICs.
sam: what about severance/outplacement if roles are reduced? is that still being discussed?
lina: we haven't finalized any reductions. planning is for transfers where possible. if reductions happen, we'll follow local legal + standard severance. People Ops will share policy drafts this week.
olivia: curious on timeline for budget approvals — if a hiring manager loses a headcount, how fast does Finance reallocate? some teams cannot delay contractor hiring.
matt: Finance will prioritize reallocation requests for top-priority product work. expect 3 business days for standard requests, 24-48 hours for priority buckets. managers should log requests in the finance portal and tag "transfer-urgent".
jamie: does this affect open offers? we have two candidates mid-process.
lina: continue with offers for priority roles. for offers in non-priority buckets, recruiting will pause new onsite scheduling pending the freeze window. offers already accepted should not be rescinded.
rachael: practical note: if you're handing someone over, set a 10-day overlap and a written ownership doc in the team repo. keeps things auditable.
sam: will there be guidance for career ladders? folks worry transfers equal stalled promotions.
lina: promotions and career progression continue. transfers won't reset performance clocks. if someone's in a promotion cycle, reach out to People Ops and their manager and we'll preserve the timeline.
jamie: thanks. also, what about external customer messaging? who signs those off?
rachael: customer-facing comms: product/CS manager drafts, legal & sales review if it mentions SLAs or roadmap changes, exec sponsor signs off. we'll add a template.
oli (olivia): could we get a simple org-change FAQ so ICs can reference right away? reduces DM volume.
lina: yes — publishing an FAQ + manager talking points by EOD. it will include: transfer rationale, timeline, compensation/benefits Qs, and where to send exceptions.
dev-bot: doc-publish: "people-ops/manager-handoff-checklist.md" at 2461239978
jamie: can People Ops add a quick flowchart? visuals help non-engineering managers.
lina: will do. also adding a short Loom for managers on how to run a handoff 1:1.
matt: one more ops ask: please document temporary on-call swaps and update PagerDuty entries before the transfer effective date.
rachael: agreed. follow the PD playbook in infra-ops. we'll host a live Q&A tomorrow at 11am for managers only — calendar invite incoming.
sam: appreciated. last tiny ask: will there be a readout after wave-1 so teams understand impact?
rachael: yes — we'll publish a short wave-1 readout (metrics: headcount moved, number of open offers affected, customer incidents) within 5 business days of completion.
rachael: thanks everyone, will post links here when docs are live. :sparkles:
__notes: All-hands follow-up thread capturing manager questions about transfers, manager checklist, finance reallocation SLAs, offers, promotion/career guidance, customer comms, and deliverables + timeline. Short Slack-style messages.
